_comment: pline.c vpline() for makemon.c's appearance lines (makemon.c:1490-1499) when #wizloadlua tut-1 creates monsters outside level creation. A blessed potion of monster detection lets the hero sense every monster, so the lichen's, yellow mold's and wolf's lines all print; C prints each before the next des.monster() runs, so the wolf's line waits at the earlier line's --More--. The port runs those creations' message tails concurrently, which a shared in_pline counter misread as nested vpline() calls and raw_print()ed (js/tty_message.js vplineRawPrint()). Seed, character and clock were chosen independently.
